csv_project_name: AE Services for Academic Building Ottensman Hall Renovations
csv_scope_of_work: The State of Wisconsin, Department of Administration (DOA), Division of Facilities Development (DFD) is inviting submissions from firms who are interested and qualified in providing Consultant/Architect/Engineer Services for the project referenced above. This project will renovate Ottensman Hall to repurpose it from a 1960 s era engineering building to a modern academic and student services building. Immediately following capital renewal, the functions currently housed in four relic 1950 s and 1960 s era buildings; Brigham, Gardner, Royce, and Warner Halls be permanently relocated. This project will then raze the vacant Brigham, Gardner, Royce, and Warner Halls.
